description: The Anywhere Door lets you travel to almost any place instantly by simply opening it. However, it has a limited range (usually 10 light-years), can be affected by electromagnetic interference, and doesn't normally allow time travel or access to other dimensions.
howItWorks: You simply think or choose your destination, set it on the Anywhere Door, and open it. Walk through the doorway to instantly arrive at your chosen location!

description: The Take-copter is a small bamboo helicopter that attaches to your head and lets you fly through the air. It's easy to use, portable, and allows you to travel without needing any vehicles.
howItWorks: Place the Take-copter on top of your head, make sure it's attached properly😅, and switch it on. It'll start spinning and lift you into the air. Just think about where you want to go and fly!

description: The Time Machine allows you to travel to different periods in the past or future. Simply choose your desired date and time, enter the machine, and let it take you to another era.
howItWorks: Set your destination date and time using the controls, then start the Time Machine. Once activated, sit back and wait until you arrive at your chosen point in time.

description: The Time Cloth is a special cloth that can change an object's age. Depending on which side you use, it can make things older or restore them to how they were when they were new.
howItWorks: Place the Time Cloth over an object and rub it gently. One side makes the object older, while the other turns it back to its original state.

description: The Copying Toast is a gadget that lets you memorize anything written on a piece of paper. Just press it against the text, and the writing gets copied onto the toast.
howItWorks: Place a slice of Copying Toast over the text you want to copy, press it gently, and then eat it to memorize everything written on it.

name.ja: ほんやくコンニャク - Translation Konjac

description: The Translation Gummy is a special candy that lets you understand and speak any language. Once eaten, it allows you to communicate with people who speak languages you don't know.
howItWorks: Simply eat the Translation Gummy and you'll be able to understand and speak other languages for a limited time.

description: The Small Light is a gadget that can shrink almost anything it shines on. It can turn large objects, animals, and even people into much smaller versions of themselves.
howItWorks: Point the Small Light at the object or person you want to shrink and press the button. The light will reduce their size instantly

description: The Big Light is a gadget that can enlarge almost anything it shines on, making objects, animals, and people grow much bigger than their original size.
howItWorks: Point the Big Light at the object or person you want to enlarge and press the button. The light will increase their size instantly.

description: The Gourmet Tablecloth is a magical tablecloth that can produce almost any food you wish for, turning an ordinary meal into a delicious feast.
howItWorks: Spread the tablecloth on a flat surface, sit down, and say the name of the food you want. The requested dish will appear right on the tablecloth.

description: The What-If Phone Booth is a gadget that lets you enter an alternate world where reality works according to your wishes. You can imagine a change to the world, and the booth creates a reality where that change has always existed.
howItWorks: Enter the booth, pick up the phone, and describe how you want the world to be different. Once activated, the world outside will change to match your scenario.

description: The Spy Set is a collection of gadgets designed to help you secretly observe people, gather information, and investigate places without being noticed.
howItWorks: Use the different tools included in the set to watch your surroundings, listen from a distance, and collect information while staying hidden.

description: The Slow Pills reduce the body's energy and slow down its activity, making the person who takes them move and react much more slowly.
howItWorks: Simply swallow a Slow Pill to slow down your body's energy and activity.
